name: hearthroom
description: Open role-card community: registry, search and ranking (Cloudflare Workers + D1)

scripts.typecheck: npm run updates:build && wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run updates:build && node --test scripts/card-identity-migration.test.mjs scripts/card-cutover.test.mjs scripts/updates/entries.test.mjs scripts/updates/check-commits.test.mjs && vitest run && npm run test -w web
scripts.build: npm run updates:build && npm run build:stage && npm run build -w web
scripts.predeploy: npm run preflight && npm run typecheck && npm run build:stage && npm run test && npm run build:web
scripts.build:stage: npm --prefix stage ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix stage run build:stage && npm --prefix stage run build:sandbox && node scripts/copy-sandbox.mjs
